name: browser-use
headline: ccstatusline customizable CLI status
short_description: Customizable statusline for Claude Code CLI. Supports powerline, themes, and more. Ideal for developers who want to enhance their terminal experience with AI tools.
author: sirmalloc

sections.overview:
ccstatusline is a customizable statusline utility designed for Claude Code CLI, enabling developers to enhance their terminal interface with powerline themes and status widgets. It provides terminal width probing and configuration options, allowing users to tailor the statusline display to their workflow. The skill supports environment variable overrides like CCSTATUSLINE_WIDTH for explicit control, making it adaptable to various terminal configurations and IDE integrations. Developers benefit from improved terminal visibility and status awareness when using Claude Code for AI-assisted development. The tool is actively maintained with features like remote control status widgets and live theme preview capabilities.
Display real-time token usage and session costs while working in the terminal.
Customize the status line to show the current git branch and repository status.
Track progress through Claude Code blocks with a visual block timer.
Easily configure multiple status lines for different projects or workflows.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/sirmalloc/ccstatusline`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
